content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech./M.E./M.S. or equivalent in relevant engineering fields with GATE, or a B.Tech./B.E. with a valid GATE score, or an M.Sc. in Materials Science/Physics/Nanoscience and Technology with a valid GATE or UGC/CSIR-JRF qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the prevailing government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Indore JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Indore JRF recruitment must be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post involves merit-based shortlisting followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents do I need to attach with my application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Indore is a contractual role.
